records.failureSummary: Delivered test/persist.store.test.mjs (15 AC-numbered node:test cases) covering persist.mjs and store serialization, using only throwaway temp dirs under os.tmpdir() and no external services. RED phase: the test file was re-pointed at stub (unimplemented) persist/store modules and run; all 15 tests failed (0 pass / 15 fail, exit 1) with the AC-numbered names visible, proving the tests genuinely exercise loadData/saveData/store.toJSON/fromJSON rather than passing vacuously. GREEN phase: against the existing implementation the full suite is 16/16 pass (1 pre-existing app test + 15 new), and npm run build and npm run lint both exit 0. Coverage: [AC-01..03] loadData fallback to { items: [], nextId: 1 } on missing file, invalid JSON, and 8 invalid-shape payloads, asserting a fresh non-shared fallback; [AC-04] valid data returned verbatim; [AC-05] saveData recursive nested parent-dir creation; [AC-06] write then loadData read-back equality plus no leftover .tmp in the target dir; [AC-07] rename overwrite of an existing target with no .tmp residue; [AC-08] failure path (circular payload) keeps an existing target intact and never creates a half-written new target, with no temp residue; [AC-09] fromJSON(toJSON()) round-trip preserves observable state and nextId; [AC-10] toJSON() shape is exactly { items, nextId } with item keys { id, title, done }; [AC-11] fromJSON accepts the loadData fallback; [AC-12] toJSON() output passed to saveData is read back equal by loadData; [AC-13..15] temp-dir-only, loadData is read-only, and mkdir is idempotent. No product code was modified by this task; the src/persist.mjs and src/store.mjs modifications shown by git status are pre-existing from sibling tasks T3/T4/T5. The scratch RED harness was removed, so the tree contains only src/, test/ and package.json.
